response.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.WBC) AS average_wbc, AVG(l.HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(l.HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_stats) SELECT s.patient_id, s.sex, s.average_wbc, s.ratio, s.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference FROM patient_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A patient's HGB/HCT ratio is their average HGB divided by their average HCT. A zero average HCT makes the ratio missing.

alternatives.interpretation: Average each patient's laboratory record HGB/HCT ratios, using only records with both values and a nonzero HCT.
